rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for trousers or pants worn as an outer garment.

example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 fu3 taai3 coeng4 laa3

rows.note: Use this specifically for underpants rather than ordinary outer trousers.

example.english: I changed my pants this morning.
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 wun6 zo2 tiu4 dai2 fu3
